blocks.text: WASHINGTON — Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky branded Vladimir Putin a “killer” in an interview broadcast on Friday, after President Donald Trump described the Russian leader as his “friend.” “For us he’s an enemy, and of course, for us, he is a killer. And I think mostly for the people in the world, he is a killer,” Zelensky told CNN in response to a question about Trump’s description of Putin.
